comment: Theres not really a true insight moment here. Additionally, the audience isn't asked to find the way to solve in the fewest moves. I propose "can you solve this in 21 moves" angle for this. Removes the burden of having to show a proof. Then we can just show the animation and mention that this is an optimal solution. I think we could even start at 4 frogs and have level 2 be 6 frogs! It took me a while to work out the solution myself.
